subject: accountancy
chapter_title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm – Retirement/Death of a Partner

concepts.title: New Profit Sharing Ratio after Retirement or Death
concepts.definition: The updated fraction of future earnings distributed among surviving partners, comprising their original portions plus the fractions acquired from the outgoing partner.
concepts.key_idea: Surviving partners increase their proportion by acquiring the departing partner's share.
question_patterns: calculate new profit sharing ratio
find the new ratio between continuing partners
what is the new profit sharing ratio after retirement
how much will each partner share in future profits

solution_steps.action: calculate acquired share from retiring partner
solution_steps.explain: multiply the retiring partner's share by the partner's gaining fraction
add the acquired portion to the existing old profit share

concepts.title: Gaining Ratio of Continuing Partners
concepts.definition: The proportion in which remaining partners absorb the profit fraction surrendered by a retiring or deceased partner.
concepts.key_idea: Surplus fraction gained by each continuing partner relative to their previous holding.
question_patterns: calculate the gaining ratio
find gaining share of continuing partners
what is the gaining ratio between surviving partners
determine how much share each partner gained

solution_steps.action: calculate net gain for the partner
solution_steps.explain: deduct the old profit share from the specified new profit share

concepts.title: Retiring or Deceased Partner's Share of Goodwill
concepts.definition: The monetary compensation due to an outgoing partner for their accumulated contribution to the reputation and earning power of the firm.
concepts.key_idea: Gaining partners compensate the departing partner in proportion to their gained shares.
question_patterns: calculate retiring partner's share of goodwill
find compensation payable for goodwill on retirement
what is the deceased partner's share in firm goodwill
determine amount of goodwill to be credited to outgoing partner

solution_steps.explain: apply the outgoing partner's profit share to total firm goodwill

solution_steps.action: calculate contribution payable by a gaining partner
solution_steps.explain: multiply the outgoing goodwill share by the partner's relative gaining fraction

concepts.title: Hidden Goodwill on Retirement
concepts.definition: The implicit value of firm goodwill identified when the agreed settlement amount exceeds the net adjusted capital balance of the retiring partner.
concepts.key_idea: Excess payout over the audited net claim represents the outgoing partner's unrecorded goodwill share.
question_patterns: calculate hidden goodwill on retirement
find the unrecorded goodwill share paid to retiring partner
what is the value of hidden goodwill
determine the excess payment attributable to goodwill

solution_steps.action: compute retiring partner's share of hidden goodwill
solution_steps.explain: deduct the adjusted capital claim from the total lump sum settlement agreed upon
divide the retiring partner's goodwill by their profit fraction

concepts.title: Profit or Loss on Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities
concepts.definition: The net financial variation arising from updating asset values and settling liabilities to present market conditions upon reconstitution.
concepts.key_idea: Net revaluation gains or losses are allocated among all existing partners in their old profit ratio.
question_patterns: calculate profit or loss on revaluation
find net balance in revaluation account
what is partner's share in revaluation profit
determine revaluation gain or loss distributable on retirement

solution_steps.action: calculate net revaluation profit or loss
solution_steps.explain: deduct asset reductions and liability increments from asset additions and liability write-downs
multiply net revaluation profit by the individual partner's old profit share

concepts.title: Distribution of Accumulated Reserves and Balances
concepts.definition: The allocation of undistributed reserves or retained surplus/deficit among all partners based on their pre-existing sharing terms.
concepts.key_idea: Past profits or losses accumulated prior to retirement belong to all partners in their old profit-sharing ratio.
question_patterns: calculate retiring partner's share in general reserve
find distribution of accumulated profit on retirement
what is the share of reserve credited to retiring partner
determine amount transferred from reserve fund to partner capital

solution_steps.explain: multiply total undistributed reserves by the partner's old profit share

concepts.title: Intervening Period Profit Share on Time Basis
concepts.definition: The estimated operational profit credited to a deceased or mid-year retiring partner for the period between the previous balance sheet and the exit date.
concepts.key_idea: Proportionate time allocation of past annual performance applied to the partner's profit fraction.
question_patterns: calculate share of profit up to date of death on time basis
find interim profit share of retiring partner using previous year profit
what is the deceased partner's accrued profit based on average profits
compute profit share for intervening period

solution_steps.action: calculate interim profit of the firm
solution_steps.explain: prorate annual base profit across the fraction of the year elapsed
multiply the firm's period profit by the departing partner's profit share

concepts.title: Intervening Period Profit Share on Turnover Basis
concepts.definition: The estimation of accrued profits for an outgoing partner by projecting past profit-to-turnover ratios onto actual sales recorded during the interim period.
concepts.key_idea: Using historical sales profitability margin to derive interim earnings.
question_patterns: calculate deceased partner profit share based on sales
find profit to date of death on turnover basis
what is partner share of profit calculated on sales ratio
determine interim profit share using current sales figures

solution_steps.action: estimate total firm profit for the intervening period
solution_steps.explain: apply prior period profitability percentage to interim sales
multiply estimated interim firm profit by partner's profit fraction

concepts.title: Adjustment of Continuing Partners' Capitals
concepts.definition: The realignment of remaining partners' capital balances to match their new profit sharing ratios by injecting or withdrawing funds.
concepts.key_idea: Target capital is split in the new profit ratio and contrasted against net existing balances to establish cash flow.
question_patterns: calculate cash to be brought in or withdrawn to adjust capital
determine required capital of continuing partners
find surplus or deficit in partner capital account after retirement
what amount of additional capital must a partner introduce

solution_steps.action: determine target capital for the partner
solution_steps.explain: multiply total required new firm capital by the partner's new ratio fraction
deduct existing adjusted capital from the newly determined target capital

concepts.title: Interest on Retiring Partner's Unpaid Loan Balance
concepts.definition: Interest computed periodically on the outstanding balance owed to a retired partner or executor when settled via deferred installments.
concepts.key_idea: Accrued interest on unpaid debt is added to the installment claim as per deed terms or statutory provisions.
question_patterns: calculate interest on retiring partner loan account
find interest due on unpaid balance of deceased partner
what is the annual interest on partner loan
how much interest is payable on outstanding capital balance

solution_steps.explain: multiply outstanding principal by the agreed annual interest rate and period fraction
combine agreed principal installment and accrued interest

questions: Aparna, Manisha and Sonia are partners sharing profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. Manisha retires and goodwill of the firm is valued at Rs. 1,80,000. Aparna and Sonia decided to share future in the ratio of 3 : 2. Record necessary journal entries.

Sangeeta, Saroj and Shanti are partners sharing profits in the ratio of 2 : 3 : 5. Goodwill is appearing in the books at a value of Rs. 60,000. Sangeeta retires and goodwill is valued at Rs. 90,000. Saroj and Shanti decided to share future profits equally. Record necessary journal entries.

Himanshu, Gagan and Naman are partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3 : 2 : 1. On March 31, 2019, Naman retires. Revalue assets and liabilities: Building appreciated by 20%, Plant & Machinery depreciated by 10%, Provision 5% on debtors, Stock at Rs. 18,000, Investment at Rs. 35,000. Prepare revaluation account.

Naresh, Raj Kumar and Bishwajeet are equal partners. Raj Kumar decides to retire. The Balance Sheet showed General Reserves Rs. 36,000 and Profit and Loss Account (Dr.) Rs. 15,000. Record the necessary journal entries.

Digvijay, Brijesh and Parakaram were partners sharing profits in the ratio of 2 : 2 : 1. Brijesh retired on March 31, 2020. Goodwill valued at Rs. 70,000, Bad debts Rs. 2,000 written off, Patents valueless. Prepare Revaluation Account, Partners' Capital Accounts and Balance Sheet.

Puneet, Pankaj and Pammy are partners in ratio 2:2:1. Pammy died on September 30, 2019. Intervening profit calculated on previous year basis, goodwill on 3 years' purchase of 4-year average, interest on capital @ 12% p.a., drawings Rs. 10,000. Prepare Pammy's Capital and Executor's account.

Narang, Suri and Bajaj are partners sharing profits in ratio 1/2, 1/6 and 1/3. Bajaj retires. Revalue premises (+20%), stock (+15%), machinery (-10%), furniture (-7%), bad debts reserve to Rs. 1,500, goodwill Rs. 21,000. Adjust capitals in new profit sharing ratio through current accounts.

Arti, Bharti and Seema are partners in ratio 3:2:1. Bharti died on June 12, 2020. Calculate interest on capital @ 10% p.a., share in reserves, interim profit on turnover basis (sales Rs. 1,00,000 at 10% profit rate), and goodwill based on twice 3-year average profit less 20%. Prepare Executor's account.
